title: ZoneCoord
description: Strike-zone coordinate, catcher's perspective, normalized to the batter's zone (spec §3.1). x: 0=middle of plate, -1/+1 = zone edges (negative = third-base side, absolute; flip by handedness at render). y: 0=bottom of zone, 1=top. Values outside [-1,1]/[0,1] are valid out-of-zone locations. Never clamp.
